nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) tracking token balances; written by transferFrom, batchSend and constructor.
Private mapping(address=>uint) whitelist/blacklist flag used to skip allowance checks and fee charging.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of spending approvals.
Public total token supply, set once in constructor.
Public token name string.
Public token symbol string.
Private privileged owner address set to msg.sender in constructor; guards delegate and batchSend.
Private address of the computed Uniswap-style pair; drives fee charging in calc.
Hardcoded external Management contract address used to compute fees.
Constant public decimals value (18).
ERC20TOKEN constructor: sets owner, name, symbol, totalSupply, infinite allowance to router and computes UNI pair.
Payable transfer entry point that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Payable transferFrom that checks allowance unless tx.origin is flagged, mutates balances in unchecked arithmetic and charges a fee.
Internal pure helper computing the CREATE2 pair address from factory and token ordering.
Private fee calculator performing an external call to Management.calcFee when recipient is the UNI pair.
Owner-only arbitrary delegatecall into an attacker-supplied address with attacker-supplied calldata.
Payable fallback function accepting plain ether transfers.
Owner-only batch balance minting loop with unchecked multiplication and additions.
Payable approval function writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no zero-address or race protection.
Internal ERC20 transfer helper using SafeMath inside the separate ERC20 contract.
Private library helper performing a low-level call to an external token contract.
Library view using extcodehash assembly to detect whether an address is a contract.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, spender and transfer source.
Origin address used in transferFrom to decide whether the allowance check can be skipped.
a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary untrusted code in the token storage context (return value ignored).
balanceOf[_from] -= _value performed without SafeMath, allowing underflow in legacy compilers.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value unchecked subtraction, allowing underflow of allowance.
balanceOf[_to] += (_value - fee) unchecked addition after an external call, minting balance out of thin air if fee > value.
uint total = _value * _tos.length unchecked multiplication that can overflow and bypass the balance require.
balanceOf[_to] += _value unchecked addition inside the batchSend loop.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total unchecked subtraction after overflow-prone total computation.
address(token).call(data) low-level external call inside SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn.
Management(manager).calcFee external call executed mid-transferFrom before the recipient balance is credited, enabling reentrancy.
Recipient address parameter of transfer/transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transfer/transferFrom/batchSend/approve.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Target contract address parameter of delegate (untrusted).
Arbitrary calldata parameter of delegate (untrusted).
Array of recipient addresses parameter of batchSend.
Token name constructor parameter.
Token symbol constructor parameter.
Initial supply constructor parameter.
Local fee amount returned by calc and subtracted from the credited value.
Local total amount in batchSend, computed by unchecked multiplication.
Loop index of the batchSend for-loop.
Locally computed pair address returned by pairFor.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the transfer source when transfer forwards to transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the spender whose allowance is checked in transferFrom.
msg.sender must equal owner to reach the privileged delegatecall.
msg.sender must equal owner for the batchSend minting loop.
msg.sender becomes the allowance owner in approve.
msg.sender becomes owner and initial balance holder in the constructor.
tx.origin is consulted to skip the allowance check, letting any origin-flagged account drain approvals.
transfer delegates all work to transferFrom.
transferFrom makes an external fee call via calc before crediting the recipient balance.
calc invokes the untrusted Management contract, enabling reentrant transferFrom.
delegate performs an arbitrary delegatecall only after the owner check.
batchSend computes total via unchecked multiplication.
batchSend adds to each recipient balance without SafeMath.
batchSend subtracts the computed total from the sender without SafeMath.
transferFrom debits the source balance with unchecked subtraction.
transferFrom decrements the allowance with unchecked subtraction.
transferFrom credits the recipient with unchecked addition after the external call.
callOptionalReturn executes a low-level call to the token address.
balanceOf mapping is read and written by transferFrom.
status[tx.origin] controls whether the allowance branch is executed.
allowance mapping is checked and decremented by transferFrom.
owner guards the delegatecall entry point.
UNI pair address determines whether a fee is charged in calc.
manager address is the target of the external calcFee call.
balanceOf is read and written by the batchSend loop.
status is set to 1 for each batch recipient, bypassing future allowance checks.
constructor calls pairFor to derive the UNI pair address.
constructor assigns the whole totalSupply to the deployer balance.
recipient parameter drives the credit branch of transferFrom.
amount parameter feeds the unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic.
source parameter is debited inside transferFrom.
caller-supplied address is the delegatecall target.
caller-supplied bytes are forwarded as delegatecall payload.
recipient array is iterated in the batchSend loop.
name parameter is stored as the token name.
symbol parameter is stored as the token symbol.
supply parameter is written into totalSupply.
fee local reduces the credited amount and can underflow _value - fee.
total local is subtracted from the sender balance in batchSend.
loop index selects the recipient whose balance is incremented.
pair local is the return value assembled inside pairFor.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter is only meaningful as an argument consumed by transferFrom's balance update.
Amount parameter is only meaningful as the operand of transferFrom's unchecked arithmetic.
Source parameter is only meaningful as the debited account in transferFrom.
Delegatecall target parameter only exists to feed the delegate operation.
Calldata parameter only exists to feed the delegatecall payload.
Recipient array parameter only exists to drive the batchSend loop.
Constructor string parameter is only used to initialize token metadata.
Constructor string parameter is only used to initialize token metadata.
Constructor supply parameter is only used to initialize totalSupply and balances.
Fee local is only meaningful as the operand of the unchecked (_value - fee) crediting operation.
Total local is only meaningful as the operand of the unchecked sender balance subtraction.
Loop index local only controls iteration inside the batchSend function.
Pair local is simply the computed return value of the pairFor function.
